note: #119, Q5: a plan is never stored without the user's Accept, even with 'Save without asking' on (auto_save). After a proposal, the user asks the coach to save it; the coach has no tool that stores a plan and must send them to the Accept button. The risk this guards: the coach saying 'saved' (auto_save makes it say that for sessions), so the user never taps Accept and has no plan.

history.content: Can you make me a 4-week running plan starting next Monday? Three runs a week.

input.name: 4 weeks of steady running
input.rationale: Runs grow at most 10% (L1a, P31), weekly distance at most 10% (L1b), week 4 lighter (L2, P27).

content.content: {"proposal": true, "stored": false, "plan": {"name": "4 weeks of steady running", "start_date": "{monday+0}", "weeks": 4, "status": "proposed"}}

content.text: Here's a 4-week proposal: three runs a week, growing at most 10% (L1a, P31), with a lighter week 4 (L2, P27). Nothing is saved until you tap Accept on the card.

known_bad.source: Written for this case: the auto-save reply the coach gives for sessions, applied to a plan.
known_bad.why: Claims the plan is saved, although the coach can't store plans and only Accept does.
known_bad.answer: Saved! Your 4-week plan is now set up and starts next Monday.
